answer: Sybil resistance works better as a slow ramp than as a captcha: a fresh identity gains attestation weight only by settling real epochs over days, so every cloned wallet restarts from zero. The ocean of throwaway keys never closes the delta between birth and trust, while a trellis of age and paid work carries the honest ones. Cloning then costs the attacker the full waiting period again per identity, and time cannot be parallelised.
